name: pokemon-party-builder
description: ポケモン構築補完＆自動生成システム - Full Stack

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ..
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.build:manual: npm run build:frontend && npm run copy:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dirs = ['frontend/build', 'backend/public']; dirs.forEach(d => { if (fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Deleted: ' + d); })"
